About Me

Technical expertise and a drive for project delivery excellence.

My Story

I’m a results-driven Structural BIM Engineer with a B.Sc. in Civil Engineering from Benha University (2021). I’m proficient in Autodesk Revit Structure, Navisworks and AutoCAD, with a strong track record in producing shop drawings, performing clash detection and coordinating multi-discipline BIM models. My background spans site engineering, technical office work and BIM, and I’m now aiming for a BIM leadership role where I can drive delivery excellence.
